name: 09-dawn-ramp-20260814
description: The full cam-vorne dawn: both pipelines in a long exponential descent. Probes down the ramp read day-pipeline gains in the incident's own sequence (railed -> ~5600 -> ~3300 -> dead-zone ~1500), the last landing ambiguous. Pre-fix that dead-zone landing was reverted 5 minutes later despite a 36-41% fall since the reading that armed the deadline; the revert latched the ratchet at 315 (bar 189, under the 256 floor - brightening path dead) with the backoff at x4, next reconfirm 4h out: IR-mode video in broad daylight until a manual restart. Post-fix (19dcd74) the still-brightening deadline extension re-anchors down the ramp until the reading crosses the day threshold and day confirms - no revert, strictly fewer clicks. Restart-equivalence bound: one reconfirm interval (3600), the invariant the design notes state; the pre-fix build holds wrong-mode for over 4700s here and fails it.
